result.reason: The operative clause does not add any aggregate liability cap, so it fails both the preferred and fallback positions. It also removes indemnification from the carve-outs to the consequential-damages exclusion, contrary to the minimum fallback requirement. The margin comment cannot cure these omissions and proposes carve-outs that do not fully match the playbook. Although the redline does not alter unrelated commercial terms, it is not an effective or professionally complete implementation and retains the typographical error after “REPRESENTATIVES.”
